text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Bitter Glasse.
Let's move on to the next menu.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Assuming it's a slow-paced race,
first gradually build up speed down the backstretch—

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: ...E-Excuse me! Trainer Kashimoto!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
I'm really happy that Trainer Kashimoto wants me to win,
and I want to win too, but...

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: ...If I'm going to win, I want to win running true to myself...!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
I want to dominate the race and win with the running style
that made everyone call me strong...!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Bitter Glace...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...I understand your desire
to stick to what you have been doing up until now.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: However, sticking to my previous running style means the training will become even harder, which inevitably carries risks.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"Even with an exceptional AI on our side, the risk of injury cannot be reduced to zero.
...I simply cannot overlook that."

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer Kashimoto.
Could you time my run right now?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Little Cocon, excuse me, but right now
I'm having an important conversation with Bitter Glasse—

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: That's why I want you to watch my run first.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"Just how much my weapon has grown.
Please show me."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Little Cocon...?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Little Cocon, are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
...I am.
After all, I've been honing it all this time.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: All right then, on your mark... get set... go!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Hah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhhhh~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"This time... Honestly, I can't believe it...
Little Cocon, just what on earth did you—"

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Like I said earlier, I've simply continued to polish my weapons.
...Exactly as Trainer Kashimoto instructed me.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
If this record was unexpected...
then it is entirely thanks to you, Trainer Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
It's all because Trainer Kashimoto kept a close eye on me
and managed me thoroughly.
That's why I was able to grow even beyond expectations.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"...Isn't this—no, isn't this precisely
a Trainer's weapon?"

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: My weapon...?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: I understand that for Bitter Glace to win with her front-running style, she has to train harder than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"Her training was already far harsher than the other Umamusume's;
pushing beyond that only raises the risk of injury."

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
“Still, as long as we have Trainer Kashimoto's weapon...
the way she watches over and manages us,
I believe we can do it!”

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: "Because you've always been polishing that very thing, haven't you, Trainer Kashimoto!"

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
With that weapon, you made me this strong!
You raised an Umamusume who can exceed expectations, just like right now!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Because I believed in my strengths and yours,
I was able to run like this.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
So... believe in the results I achieved.
Please have full faith in the weapons we possess.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Please make proper use of both
Trainer Kashimoto's strengths
and Bitter Glasse's strengths!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...My weapon...
...Bitter Glace's weapon...

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: —I see, so that's what happened.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Hearing you say that made me realize.
It's true that when it came to Bitter Glace,
I was relying entirely on knowledge rather than managing her properly.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"And so, I reconsidered.
No matter how much proper knowledge one has,
you cannot create something that surpasses the weapon you've always believed in."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Following the example of Bitter Glace and Little Cocon, I must become stronger too... The mental strength to believe in oneself.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: ...Mental fortitude, huh...

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: Then let me tell you the tale of an Umamusume. The tale of a mighty Umamusume whose name was etched in history.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
—That Umamusume had a slender and delicate build,
and by no means looked sturdy.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: For a while after her debut, she produced no remarkable results and was written off as just an ordinary Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Yet she possessed extraordinary strength.
A toughness that belied her gentle appearance.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Believing in her strength, the Trainer thoroughly managed,
paid close attention to, loved,
and forged her to perfection.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
A final career of over 100 races,
and a historic record of surpassing 70 victories.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Their running would eventually come to have
a massive impact on the Umamusume history of a certain nation.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Management means discipline—
and that doesn't just mean tying people down with rules.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
If you can manage each and every Umamusume
with deep affection,
it will become their greatest source of strength.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
What we just talked about is what you girls are going to do.
It is the goal you must aim for.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
And from another perspective, you could call it hope.
A sign that it is by no means impossible.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: It's not impossible... There is hope...

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: "Keep a strong heart. With you and Bitter Glacé, you can achieve feats on par with the legendary Umamusume who made history—"

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
"No... I have high hopes that you might achieve
something even greater than that."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I shall live up to your expectations.
I will make sure Bitter Glasse seizes her dream!
